# Stack Ai

No-Code Platform for Enterprise AI. Build, deploy, and scale AI workflows without code.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/stack-ai/.

## Actions

- **Get Provider Details** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific Stack AI tool provider.
- **Get Trigger Inputs** (read-only): Retrieve the input parameters for a trigger as a JSON schema.
- **List Connector Types** (read-only): List all available connector types from Stack AI.
- **List Provider Triggers** (read-only): Get all available triggers for a specific provider.
- **List Stack AI Actions** (read-only): List all available Stack AI tool actions.
- **List Stack AI Built-in Tools** (read-only): List all Stack AI built-in tools.
- **List Stack AI Integrations** (read-only): List all available Stack AI integrations.
- **List Stack AI Providers** (read-only): List all Stack AI tool providers (integrations).
- **Check Health** (read-only): Check the health status of the Stack AI API.
- **Get Action Inputs** (read-only): Retrieve the input schema for a specific provider action in Stack AI.
- **Get Action Output Schema** (read-only): Retrieve the output parameters schema for a Stack.ai provider action as JSON schema.
- **Get Connector Type Schema** (read-only): Retrieve the configuration schema for a specific connector type in Stack AI.
- **Get License Status** (read-only): Retrieve the current Stack AI license status.
- **Get Provider Action Details** (read-only): Get details of a specific action for a provider.
- **Get Provider Icon** (read-only): Fetch a provider icon image by provider identifier.
- **Get Provider Trigger Details** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific trigger for a provider.
- **Get Root** (read-only): Retrieve information from the Stack AI API root endpoint.
- **Get Trigger Details From Provider** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific trigger from a provider.
- **Get Trigger Outputs** (read-only): Retrieve the output schema for a specific trigger in Stack AI.
- **List Permission Groups** (read-only): List all permission groups with their associated permissions.
- **List Permissions** (read-only): List all available permissions in Stack AI.
- **List Stack AI Triggers** (read-only): List all available Stack AI tool triggers.
